subject: ClearWave deal: stabilization & owner-level save plan
messages: To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>, Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@clearwave.com>
Subject: ClearWave deal: stabilization & owner-level save plan

Following our exec call this morning I want to capture the immediate stabilization plan so finance has a clear line of sight for the forecast. At a high level ClearWave sits as a YELLOW-to-RED motion depending on two open items: final SOW sign and procurement PO timing. We need owner-confirmed actions by EOD Friday to avoid the Q3 upside getting pulled from the commit.
What I need from each internal owner:
- Marissa: customer obstructions (pricing/discount asks) — status & next touch (who, when)
- Lauren: legal/contract redlines — indicate scope and estimated turnaround
- Rafael: deployment/ops blockers for start date — list contingencies and any feature gating

Clara — please confirm Tue/Thu procurement availability and whether ProcureOps can issue a PO by 05/28 if the SOW is final. If there are outstanding internal signoffs we should note them so we can set realistic close expectations in the forecast.

Attachments: I will upload a simple risk matrix for internal owners after your replies (placeholder: clearwave-risk-matrix-2027.xlsx). I’m also attaching the latest SOW that legal routed (CW_SOW_v2.pdf) so we all have the same doc.
Subject: Re: ClearWave deal: stabilization & owner-level save plan
Thanks for the summary. Quick answers:

1) Procurement can prioritize if the SOW is final by Friday 05/21. I’ve copied ProcureOps; they need a clean SOW + our internal pricing approval memo. If pricing changes, that pushes PO timing by ~5 business days.

2) There’s one outstanding internal signoff from IT security (third-party data handling), which typically takes 7–10 business days unless we provide targeted answers to their questionnaire. We’d like to avoid that if Redwood can provide the SOC and data flow diagram quickly.

I’ve attached the version of the SOW we reviewed internally. I’ll escalate the PO window if we can confirm no further redlines. Tom Ellis from Procurement included his availability for a short call Friday 10:00–12:00 PT.
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
Subject: Re: ClearWave deal: stabilization & owner-level save plan
Sergio — quick internal update and proposed save actions. I’ve filled the risk matrix (attached) with owner-level rows so we can track status in one place.
- Commercial (Marissa) — YELLOW: Clara has pricing pushback but not a blocker. Action: send a 1-page concession summary + proposed acceptance window. Owner: Marissa. Due: 05/21 EOD.
- Legal (Lauren) — GREEN->YELLOW: two minor redlines on liability and data clauses. Action: counter redline and request a 48-hr review. Owner: Lauren. Due: 05/22 COB.

- Ops (Rafael) — GREEN: provisional kickoff date is intact, but we need signed SOW + PO to lock compute scheduling. Action: produce a contingency runbook if PO slips 5–10 business days. Owner: Rafael. Due: 05/24.
1) Sergio — can you confirm an exec sponsor call on Friday if ProcureOps needs escalation? I’ll prepare a 5-slide handoff with the risk matrix.
2) Lauren — please push the counter-redline and ping Clara directly with a short note that we can accept limited liability language with a cap tied to the first 90 days of usage.
3) Rafael — draft 2 contingency start dates (one optimistic, one conservative) and the minimal acceptance criteria for the kickoff so finance can map revenue recognition windows.
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>, Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@clearwave.com>
Subject: Re: ClearWave deal: stabilization & owner-level save plan
Thanks all — good progress. Quick confirmations and next steps before I update finance forecast:
- Marissa: expect concession summary by 05/21 EOD (will be used to lock price in forecast).
- Lauren: counter-redline to Clara by 05/21 COB; if we get a yes, procurement window looks likely for 05/28 PO issuance.
- Rafael: contingency runbook due 05/24 so finance can model revenue phasing for both kickoff scenarios.

Clara — appreciate the PO availability note. If ProcureOps can meet the 05/28 PO date contingent on legal signoff, we’ll keep this in the YELLOW commit. If PO slips beyond two weeks, we should move this to RED for the quarter forecast and I’ll adjust the commit accordingly.
I’ll prep the exec escalation slide for Friday morning (10:00 PT) in case ProcureOps requests it. Marissa — loop me in and I’ll join the call if needed.
